verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad set of APIs: event ingest, event export, read-only dashboard data, cohort list/export/upload, taxonomy CRUD and Experiment management from CI or scripts. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and several UI surfaces have no documented API counterpart. missing for 10: API creation/editing of charts and dashboards (the Dashboard REST API only reads graph data), API access to session replay, heatmaps, guides/surveys and web visual experiments, an explicit UI-parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Manage flags, experiments, and deployments from CI, scripts, or your own tools with the Experiment APIs.
Create, get, update, and delete categories, event types, event properties, and user properties.
List all your cohorts in Amplitude, export a cohort in Amplitude, or upload a cohort.
Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
Send data directly from your server to the HTTP V2 endpoint.
